sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to be in a mood to get away from the daily grind and take a much need break. You would naturally try to stay free from future concerns and commitments and keep all your woes and worries aside for the day. An adventurous and fun filled outing or a trip to some happening resort, along with your friends and family members is a near certainty, assures Ganesha. Don’t miss out on this opportunity.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It's important that you abandon the myth that you don't have any gifts or talents, Taurus. Consider thinking about your talents in the same way you think about your body. When you exercise, eat right, and get plenty of rest, your body responds. Your talents are no different. They need care and nurturing, too.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Focus on simplifying your life as the Moon moves through Libra, darling Taurus, activating the sector of your chart that governs work, wellness, and daily routines. Notice how stress disrupts your peace each day, and what you can do to minimize its impact. Prioritize your health before looking at the bigger picture. When you recognize which physical, mental, and emotional needs aren't being met, it will be easier to determine where change is needed. A sweet connection between Luna and Mars encourages you to establish new ground rules at home that center around improving efficiency and a fair division of responsibilities.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Smile as it is best antidote for all your problems. If you had borrowed some money from a member of your family, then it is best to return it today, or else that member can take legal action against you. There will be an important development on your personal front which will bring jubilation for you and your entire family. It is good to spend time alone, but you can grow anxious over something going on in your mind. Therefore, we advise you to contact an experienced person and share your troubles with them. Your spouse might deny to satisfy your needs today, which will eventually make you feel frustrated.
